scope: Only the exact pure-data helper for the already bounded Base64 relay with at most4MiB framing and an independently fixed expected byte count. This is not a relay runner, artifact authenticity or gameplay review.
static_findings: Read the complete source. It defines only constants and functions for UTF-8 encoding, strict Base64 decoding and SHA-256. No tool, network, file, process or engine operation exists in the helper.

Base64 requires a string and nonnegative safe-integer expected length no greater than32MiB. It compares exact padded encoded length before allocating output; accepts only the standard ASCII alphabet; permits padding only in the exact final remainder; checks zero unused trailing bits; and asserts the final decoded count. Whitespace, URL-safe substitutions, internal/extra padding and length mismatch cannot silently normalize into accepted bytes.

UTF-8 iterates Unicode code points, encodes paired supplementary characters as four bytes and rejects isolated UTF-16 surrogates. It preserves actual BOM/code points rather than stripping or replacing them.

SHA-256 requires Uint8Array, copies its exact view into a separate padded buffer, uses standard64-byte blocks and big-endian64-bit bit length, and applies32-bit modular schedule/compression. At the admitted input ceiling the length and arithmetic remain within exact JavaScript integer range. It does not hash bytes outside a subarray or mutate input.

The cap is an input ceiling, not a universal heap guarantee. UTF-8 checks its final byte count after accumulating its array; this is acceptable only within the stated caller-bounded text scope and must not be advertised as streaming or as preallocation protection against arbitrary unbounded strings.

Read the retained31-check report including the56-byte padding boundary and2MiB synthetic capacity observation. Those are attributed author checks, not a claim this reviewer reran all31 or inspected actual artifact bytes.

checks.name: Exact UTF-8 supplementary pair between ASCII boundaries
Unpaired low surrogate is not replacement-encoded
SHA256 respects nonzero-offset Uint8Array view and its exact length
Array view storage remains unchanged after hashing
String framing count is not coerced
Base64 encoded length rejects complete extra quartet before output use
Hash rejects raw ArrayBuffer type rather than guessing view

mandatory_caller_boundary: Enforce the at-most4MiB framing limit before helper processing and supply the independently bound exact expected byte count.

Validate original run/artifact identity, start/end framing, exact sequence and chunk count, absence of duplicates/truncation, and final independently sourced expected SHA-256. This helper does not parse or validate those facts.
Decode Base64 to Uint8Array and hash those raw bytes; do not pass arbitrary binary through UTF-8 conversion.
Do not treat a decoded-byte/hash match alone as evidence of original ZIP CRC, internal members, source acceptance or runtime/gameplay admission.
Any larger input, changed helper source, framing procedure or execution scope needs its own applicable review; this review authorizes no download, process, workflow event or ref mutation.
publication_scope: Review and supporting pure-data observations may be preserved as Git blobs; no source branch or workflow event is authorized.
